chunking: fixed characters (whitespace collapsed; never crosses a page)
metadata: document_id, source, page, chapter, chapter_title, section, document_type, language, char_start
vectorizer: intfloat/multilingual-e5-small (local, 384 dims, cosine, exact search in pgvector 0.8.7)
hypothesis: Baseline: fixed windows cut sentences and boxes in the middle, so evidence is more often split and the top-1 chunk is noisier
notes: 272 chunks; median 500 chars; embed ~9 s on CPU; cost 0. Dev: 1 evidence split (q05).

chunking: paragraph/heading aware (OpenStax block headings, sentence-end + short line = paragraph end), merge fragments < min_size, never crosses a page
hypothesis: Keeping whole paragraphs/boxes together gives more coherent chunks and a better top-1 than A at similar Hit@3
notes: 226 chunks (v2 after merging tiny fragments; v1 had 272 incl. 40 chunks < 150 chars, see results/ingest_stats_v1_before_chunk_fix.json); median 442.5 chars; embed ~9 s; cost 0.

chunking: same chunks and vectors as B (reuse)
filter: chapter = value given by user context, only for questions with a filter (q15, q16 dev; q21, q22 test); other questions run exactly like B
hypothesis: Restricting search to the chapter the user is studying removes same-topic passages from other chapters for metadata questions
notes: Only differs from B by the filter. SELECTED on dev before running test: A vs B/C tie on Evidence Hit@3 (14/16), B/C win on Hit@1 (13 vs 9). B and C tie on every pre-registered criterion; tie broken (added after dev, before test) by filter compliance: on q16 B's top-3 has 2 chunks from chapter 1, C's top-3 is fully in chapter 2.

chunking: same chunks and vectors as B (reuse)
vectorizer: same dense model + keyword full-text (PostgreSQL to_tsvector('english'), ts_rank_cd, OR of question lexemes), fused by weighted RRF: k=60, w_dense=1.0, w_keyword=0.5, depth 20
hypothesis: Keyword matching rescues evidence diluted inside long chunks (q16) and exact tokens, without hurting dense hits
notes: Added after the A/B/C test run. RRF params chosen on dev only (results/hybrid_tuning_dev.json: 9 configs; every w_keyword=0.5 config gave 12/16, 15/16; tie broken toward k=60).
